Fasting is praised for weight loss, but a new Swedish study reveals long meal gaps may speed up chronic illness in adults 78+.

Why long gaps between meals may not be healthy for older people – new study
Evidence: fasting promoted, observational link, biological caution #Health #Science

Researchers tracking nearly 3,000 older adults in Sweden found that those going 14 to 24 hours without eating developed chronic diseases faster.
